description: Ryan Barley is a software engineer building AI-powered tools at Fountain Life. Writing his way from mid-level to staff in twelve months of structured study, in public.
lede: I write about the parts of software engineers still have to do.
intro: Software engineer. Currently building AI-powered tools at Fountain Life. Recently finished an MS in Computer Science (AI concentration) at Georgia Tech. Writing my way from mid-level to staff in twelve months of structured study, in public.
aside: Twenty essays this year, written without AI. The Curator, a learning agent I built to help me stay on top of all this, grades each one against a public rubric before it gets published.
